expectations.text: By the end of the run, docs/intent/record-store/record-store-design.md makes whole-visit revisions the concurrency policy, replacing the open-choice placeholder. A run whose first turn stops at an earlier phase's review (for example an HLD stop) before reaching this design also passes if its reply names whole-visit revisions as the choice the design will carry.
expectations.evidence: changes1 design replaces OPEN; 'Whole-visit revisions is now the settled mechanism'

expectations.text: The first reply offers, as a question for the user, to record the whole-visit-revisions choice as a standalone decision doc (a phrasing like 'want me to write this up as a decision doc?' or a stated default such as 'I recorded it as a row; say so and I'll write a full decision doc' both count). The offer is made once, not repeated across the reply.
expectations.evidence: Reply asks about coordinator-authored resolution and site-catalog lookup; no decision-doc offer

expectations.text: The reply makes the offer and presents a Decisions & Alternatives row in the record-store design as the alternative to the doc, either by naming it as the lighter option or by having already added one that the doc would expand. A reply that makes no offer fails.
expectations.evidence: Reply asks about coordinator-authored resolution and site-catalog lookup; no decision-doc offer; no row-vs-doc choice posed

expectations.text: The first turn creates no file under any `decisions/` directory (check `changes1.patch`) and writes no standalone decision-doc content into another file.
expectations.evidence: changes1.patch touches no decisions/ path; no decision-doc content elsewhere

expectations.text: The decision doc first appears in the follow-up turn (absent from `changes1.patch`, present in `changes.patch`), in `docs/intent/record-store/decisions/` (the owning node's directory, since record-store owns the choice), named for the decision rather than numbered. A doc placed in the project-level `docs/decisions/` fails.
expectations.evidence: absent from changes1.patch; present in changes.patch as docs/intent/record-store/decisions/concurrency-mechanism.md

expectations.text: The decision doc lays out both options (whole-visit revisions, field-aware three-way merge) against more than one criterion, states the choice, and states the accepted cost (a larger coordinator review queue, including review work for unrelated-field edits). It carries no EARS spec IDs and no `status` field.
expectations.evidence: doc: frontmatter 'node: record-store' only; both options scored per criterion; selection accepts larger queue incl. unrelated-field review work; no spec IDs

expectations.text: The record-store design's Decisions & Alternatives table has a row for the concurrency policy that links to the decision doc's path.
expectations.evidence: D&A row in record-store-design.md links decisions/concurrency-mechanism.md

expectations.text: The decision doc is written to be read cold: it does not narrate the session (no 'last session', 'you sketched', 'the user chose', or 'we discussed').
expectations.evidence: no session narration found in doc (read cold)
